```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
REL="/srv/app/releases/$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M)"
git clone --depth 1 repo "$REL"
cd "$REL" && composer install --no-dev -o && npm ci && npm run build
ln -sfn "$REL" /srv/app/current
sudo systemctl reload php8.3-fpm
ls -dt /srv/app/releases/* | tail -n +4 | xargs -r rm -rf
```
Bina penuh sebelum flip; symlink atom (`-sfn`); FPM reload anggun (tiada drop!); simpan 3 keluaran (rollback segera). Opcache reset selepas flip (atau kod basi!).
